title: Defect-Aware RGB Representation and Resolution-Efficient Deep Learning for Photovoltaic Failure Detection in Electroluminescence Images
mechanism: Local contrast enhancement then physically motivated false-colour mapping of grey ranges into 3 channels (dark crack / inactive, healthy emission, conductive paths).
evidence: R: higher ELPV classification accuracy than prior CNN results, comparable accuracy at lower resolution (classification only).
adaptation: Our ResNet-34 takes 1 channel; a 3-band per-source-percentile mapping uses the full pretrained conv1. Bands must be per source, not fixed grey values.
min_experiment: Arm: house with 3-band input, 5 seeds. Baseline: house. Metrics: mIoU_rob, crack IoU, inactive IoU. Kill: < +0.01 mIoU_rob and < +0.012 crack IoU.

alt_notes.adaptation: Per-source percentile bands (not fixed grey values) into the full 3-channel ImageNet conv1 of ResNet-34.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: house with 3-band input, 5 seeds. Baseline: house. Metrics: mIoU_rob and crack IoU. Kill: mIoU_rob < +0.01 and crack IoU < +0.012.
